weapon.d: If a bonus granted by a skill like Rally or Hone is active on unit, grants Atk/Res+4 during combat.
If a bonus granted by a skill like Rally or Hone is active on unit, grants Atk/Res+4 during combat.

a.d: If unit initiates combat, grants Atk+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Res+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Res+4 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk+6, Res+10 during combat and foe cannot make a follow-up attack.

b.d: If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, grants Def/Res+2 to unit and target ally or unit and targeting ally for 1 turn.
If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, grants Def/Res+4 to unit and target ally or unit and targeting ally for 1 turn.
If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, grants Def/Res+6 to unit and target ally or unit and targeting ally for 1 turn.

c.d: At start of odd-numbered turns, grants Atk+2 to unit and adjacent allies for 1 turn. (Bonus granted to unit even if no allies are adjacent.)
At start of odd-numbered turns, grants Atk+4 to unit and adjacent allies for 1 turn. (Bonus granted to unit even if no allies are adjacent.)
At start of odd-numbered turns, grants Atk+6 to unit and adjacent allies for 1 turn. (Bonus granted to unit even if no allies are adjacent.)
